notes.title: v4.0.8
notes.content:
- New 64-bit binaries for improved performance on modern CPUs.
- Removed support for 32-bit OS.
- Other minor performance and stability updates.

tags.feature: - New 64-bit binaries for improved performance on modern CPUs.

notes.title: v4.0.7
notes.content: - Fixed issue with custom cards not saving immediately after changing the number of drinks.

notes.content: - Fixed crash when using % signs in custom cards.

notes.title: v4.0.1
notes.content:
- Added support for ultra-wide screens.
- Performance and stability update.

notes.title: v3.2.2
notes.content: Fixed a minor bug that would remove some challenges from the game entirely when "Truth" fields are active (and therefore making the achievement "Showmanshi(t)p" impossible). Truth be told, it's not worth if you miss out on content!

notes.title: New in v3.2.1
notes.content:
- Upgraded engine for multi-core processing to improve smoothness everywhere.
- Potentially fixed a nasty bug with custom cards that would go all Grinch mode on the game and take the fun away. :(

notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26228617/d86d691760c1851e7ea77de4404afa67300de967.png[/img]

As part of the Halloween Steam Special Sale, we pimped up some of the characters to reflect the murderous spirit of the season. Also added some ghastly ghouls that creepily watch everyone while you play. 
You're welcome ;)

Becuase no Halloween is complete without drinking. (unless you're a little kid... that drinks juice, that's awesome too, keep doing that, and get off this page)

Please drink responsibly :) ...juice
